question: Does sgl-project/DeepGEMM 22c7937a (fence_view_async_shared before empty_barriers[stage]->arrive in sm120_bf16_gemm.cuh) cure the vision-tower fault in the Miles training path?
answer: yes (no fault in 30 passes / 435 pass pairs; unpatched baseline: 35 of 45 pairs differed)
